selectionReason: phase-based work uses the full cross-runtime harness by default
runtimeIsolation: codex delegated-terminal; fresh review/verify attempts preferred
retrievalBudget: stage=1 compact recall; repeat only for missing owner/date/path/API/failure fact; stopWhenAnswerable=true; no raw graph or memory output
phaseReplayPolicy: preserve assistant phase commentary/final_answer when replaying; never add phase to user items
notes: Large or phase-based work must enter through moonshot-phase-runner.
Meaningful code changes require review evidence before verification and completion.
Finish or handoff can only begin after review and verification reach a stable state.
Incomplete phase stops require session-logger evidence in handoff artifacts.
